rows.question_text: Find the compound interest on Rs. 12,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the compound interest on Rs. 6,000 for 2 years at 20% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the compound interest on Rs. 20,000 for 3 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the compound interest on Rs. 10,000 for 2 years at 10% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the compound interest on Rs. 8,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs. 10,000 for 3 years at 10% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs. 25,000 for 2 years at 8% per annum, compounded annually.
Find the compound interest on Rs. 40,000 for 9 months at 20% per annum, compounded quarterly.
Find the compound interest on Rs. 10,000 for 6 months at 8% per annum, compounded quarterly.
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum for 2 years at 6% per annum is Rs. 180. Find the sum.
The difference between compound interest and simple interest on a sum for 3 years at 5% per annum is Rs. 183. Find the sum.

Two positions of the same dice (with faces numbered 1 to 6) are shown below:
Position 1: 1 is on top, 2 is in front, 3 is on the right side.
Position 2: 1 is on top, 4 is in front, 5 is on the right side.
Which number is on the face opposite to 1?

Three positions of the same dice (with faces numbered 1 to 6) are shown below:
Position 1: 2 is on top, 3 is in front, 4 is on the right.
Position 2: 2 is on top, 5 is in front, 6 is on the right.
Position 3: 2 is on top, 6 is in front, 3 is on the right.
Which number lies opposite to the number 2?
